text:
The formula
\begin{multline*}
  \lexists[u][(\lforall[x][(X(x) \lif Y(u(x)))] \land {}\\
    \lforall[x][\lforall[y][(\eq[u(x)][u(y)] \lif \eq[x][y])]]
  \land {} \\\lforall[y][(Y(y) \lif \lexists[x][(X(x)
      \land \eq[y][u(x)])])])]
\end{multline*}
defines the relation of being equinumerous with.
